This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.P.M.JOSHI, SIJI K.PAUL, SRUTHI SUNILKUMAR, C.GOKULKRISHNAN, ANUSHKA VIJAYAKUMAR, BONNY BABY & SURESH MATHEW, Advocates for the applicant and Standing counsel (B/O)for Respondent, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024  in  MACA.No.3777 of 2024  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 07th day of February, 2025  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellant praying for condoning the delay of 289 days in filing the appeal.

2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning Jagadeesh Chandran vs The Divisional Manager on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124266757/

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 289 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioner will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the respondent.
The learned counsel for the appellant is directed to serve a copy of the appeal memorandum to the learned Standing Counsel.
Post after two months for settlement.
